vol.note: Rotates correctly, runic details are nice.

seek.note: CSS fill/track is a flat rectangle that does not blend into the carved slot and visibly overflows behind the thumb.

shuffle.note: The bone toggle switch did not move between the idle and interacted frames.

album_art.note: Visible pseudo-English text 'G F R' baked into the stone underneath the frame.

notes: The dark gothic Diablo theme is executed beautifully with great material fidelity for the stone, iron, and demonic accents.
Unfortunately, a dead toggle switch and an unstyled CSS track on the slider ruin the functional illusion.
Also has baked-in letters masquerading as runes.
improve: Ensure the shuffle toggle switch has distinct ON and OFF sprites so it actually changes position when clicked.
Remove the flat CSS track from the slider, or mask it properly so it stays within the carved groove.
Scrub the pseudo-English letters ('G F R') below the album art.
